topics.description: Multiple sources report on a significant fraud investigation in Minnesota's child care assistance program. The investigation has led to a federal anti-fraud task force being formed and several related probes into medical schools and other areas.

topics.topic: Texas Child Care Spending Fraud Review
topics.description: Following the Minnesota scandal, Texas reviewed its child care spending and found little fraud. This contrasts with the issues found in Minnesota and suggests potential discrepancies in fraud detection or occurrence across states.
